title: 转动、振动和量子涨落
scope_boundary: 系统阐述一维简谐振动教学模型（明确坐标、质量与刚度量纲）、量子基态零点涨落与势能极小点及跃迁矩阵元的本质区别、三维空间转动量子化与 Casimir 能标、基态电四极矩 Q_s(0+)=0 的角动量几何本质与 Kumar-Cline 形状不变量、内禀形状变量与欧拉取向角的分离条件及声子数标签的近似边界、浅软势能面多阱隧穿与量子波包概率密度分布，以及平滑引向第3章后续转动动力学展开的接口。

source_inputs.canonical_source: A. Bohr & B. R. Mottelson, Nuclear Structure, Vol. II: Nuclear Deformations, World Scientific (1998 reissue, local copy 1999 reprint)
source_inputs.actual_read_pages: printed pp. 1–6 (PDF pp. 23–28, Section 4-1 / 4-2); printed pp. 345–365 (PDF pp. 367–387, Chapter 6 Section 6-2)
text_anchors: printed p. 4: 'The condition that the fluctuations in shape be small compared with the average deformation, Delta R << R_0, is therefore equivalent to the adiabatic condition omega_rot << omega_vib'
printed p. 5: 'The intrinsic motion is described by coordinates q and conjugate momenta p... rotational Hamiltonian does not depend on orientation omega... product form Psi = D Phi'
printed p. 347: quadrupole collective Hamiltonian H = T + V with mass parameter B and stiffness C, zero-point fluctuation <0| q^2 |0> = hbar / (2 sqrt(B C))
claims_supported: 旋转与振动的绝热分离条件 omega_rot << omega_vib (printed p. 4)
内禀运动变量 q 与取向角变量 omega 的正交分解及乘积波函数 (printed p. 5)
四极集体简谐振动动能与势能展开、特征频率及基态零点涨落均方根宽度公式 (printed p. 347)

source_inputs.canonical_source: A. Bohr, Dan. Mat. Fys. Medd. 26, no. 14 (1952)
text_anchors: pp. 8–11: Transformation from laboratory alpha_{2mu} to intrinsic shape variables beta, gamma and Euler angles phi, theta, psi
claims_supported: 五维四极坐标分解为 2 个内禀形状坐标与 3 个取向欧拉角的变换结构与动能张量

source_inputs.canonical_source: D. Cline, Ann. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 36 (1986) 683–716
text_anchors: pp. 687–690: Kumar-Cline rotational scalar invariants <0+| [Q x Q]_0 |0+> proportional to q2^2 > 0 and comparison with vanishing spectroscopic quadrupole moment Q_s(0+) = 0
claims_supported: 基态 0+ 静态四极矩 Q_s(0+)=0 是角动量几何耦合的恒等结论，绝不否定内禀形变；内禀四极度由转动标量不变量 q2^2 确定

notations_and_conventions.1d_oscillator: V(q) = V_0 + (1/2) C q^2, T = p^2/(2B)；坐标 q 量纲 [q]，质量参数 B 单位 hbar^2 / (MeV * [q]^2)，刚度 C 单位 MeV / [q]^2，hbar omega = hbar sqrt(C/B) (MeV)，零点涨落 <q^2>_0 = hbar / (2 sqrt(B C))
notations_and_conventions.rotational_units: E_rot(I) = hbar^2 I(I+1) / (2 J) = A I(I+1)，I 为无量纲总角动量，A = hbar^2 / (2 J) 具能量量纲 (MeV 或 keV)，与全篇第3章约定统一

claims_and_derivations.zero_point_vs_observable: 基态零点涨落宽度由所选谐振势阱参数决定，通过完备性求和关系 <0| q^2 |0> = sum_n |<n| q |0>|^2 与跃迁响应网络强度联系，严密区分波包统计矩、单次非对角矩阵元与仪器测量误差
claims_and_derivations.casimir_and_Q0: Declared axialK0 model givesA I(I+1); additional intrinsic Ry(pi) condition selects evenI. Qs(0+)=0 and q2 uniform convention preserved; q2 alone does not prove unique intrinsicshape.
claims_and_derivations.vibration_vs_orientation: Time-scale separation plus small derivativecoupling supports specifiedadiabatic model; phonon labels and discriminating observables depend on that model, no universal absoluteB(E2) checklist.
claims_and_derivations.soft_potentials_and_tunneling: 浅软势能面中零点涨落与平衡形变尺度相当，动态波包概率分布决定有效几何；有限介观体系严格保持空间转动守恒，自发对称破缺属于内禀单粒子波包属性
claims_and_derivations.axial_signature_condition: 轴对称 K=0 转动带中仅出现偶自旋 I=0,2,4,... 的物理前提是内禀态额外具备正旋称 Ry(pi) 离散二度轴对称性，K=0 本身不迫使自旋取偶数
claims_and_derivations.adiabatic_separation_condition: 删除假等价 iff，明确绝热分离是时间尺度与导数微扰耦合判定 hbar omega_rot << hbar omega_vib，几何形变幅度另行评估
claims_and_derivations.symmetrized_product_wavefunction: Schematic expansion uses rotationfunctions varphi_IMK withnorm/phase/discreteconditions definedin2.5/AppendixB; no unnormalized universalD-product asserted.
claims_and_derivations.soft_potential_expansion_boundary: 软势面涨落与局部二次展开适用区间比较，消除 gamma_0=0 病态
claims_and_derivations.projection_trial_space_variation: 投影在受限试探空间提取良好自旋态，通过 Ritz 变分求解近似本征态，不泛称全核严格定态
claims_and_derivations.chiral_non_coplanarity_boundary: 手征非共面矢量耦合要求标量三重积非零，不强求三向量严格 90 度正交

competing_explanations_and_boundaries.phonon_vs_anharmonic: 简单的整数能量比 (如 E(4+)/E(2+) 约 2.0 或 2.5) 不足以作为判定声子模式的充分条件，强非简谐势与科里奥利耦合可产生表观相似能谱
competing_explanations_and_boundaries.static_minimum_vs_wavepacket_density: 在 gamma 软核与浅势能面中，静态极小点不能代表物理构型，真实动力学受全流形上的波包概率密度分布主导

reader_checks: 一维教学振子中，质量参数 B、刚度 C 与零点涨落 <q^2>_0 的量纲如何严格自洽？
为什么偶偶核基态 Q_s(0+) = 0 的严格守恒不能用来否定核内禀形变的存在？
为什么不能仅靠在束激发谱线上的能量比值来认定振动声子模式？
在浅软势能面中，静态势阱极小与真实物理构型之间存在怎样的本质差异？
